svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Share of cases with that radiologist finding where the model names it · held-out cases, same scorer for every model
111 held-out ChestX-Det test films · Skanda run 2: mean of 2 passes (hits shown per pass)
340 cases: MSD, DeepLesion, autoPET · slices + volumes
240 cases: MSD brain tumour, ISLES 2022 stroke · slices + volumes
X-ray: a film counts for a label when any reported finding is of that type (app benchmark scorer). CT / MRI: a case counts
when a finding names that organ or lesion type. Groups under ~15 cases are directional. Built by docs/build_disease_chart.py.
